project.description:
flower-next image build on Office WSL + push to Mac Mini registry (100.76.15.64:5001) + deploy to k3s (flower-next deployment on ubuntu-master).
触发方式: - Gitea webhook: http://100.76.15.64:13000 → Jenkins (/job/flower-next-office-deploy/buildWithParameters?token=flower-next-deploy-c1ub-2026&GIT_REF=main) - 手动: 带参数 GIT_REF (默认 main) 即可
SSH 信任: - Jenkins 公钥 (cmdb-jenkins 容器的 id_ed25519) 已经加到 dell@office-wsl 的 /home/dell/.ssh/authorized_keys - Jenkins→ubuntu-master (huangfra-ubun-master@100.96.54.109) 沿用原 BatchMode 通道
⚠️ 必须用 office-wsl 主机名（不能是 office）: - office = Windows 宿主机 sshd (OpenSSH_for_Windows), 读 C:\Users\dell\.ssh\authorized_keys, 我们加不进去 key - office-wsl = WSL2 Linux sshd, 读 /home/dell/.ssh/authorized_keys, cmdb-jenkins 公钥已写入
Image 命名: - 100.76.15.64:5001/flower-next:<短 SHA 8 位> - 100.76.15.64:5001/flower-next:latest (始终指向最近一次构建)
Deploy: - kubectl -n new-ecommerce set image deployment/flower-next flower-next=100.76.15.64:5001/flower-next:<SHA> - 删除旧 pod 触发 Recreate,等待 rollout

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: GIT_REF
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Branch/tag/SHA to build (default: main). 会被传到 office-wsl 上执行 git checkout。

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash # flower-next-office-deploy — Jenkins controller script # Flow: # 1. SSH to Office WSL (office-wsl.tail87ed61.ts.net → 100.113.60.71 currently), # run ~/bin/flower-next-office-build.sh: clones Gitea, docker build, docker push # to Mac Mini registry (100.76.15.64:5001) # 2. SSH to ubuntu-master (100.96.54.109), run ~/bin/flower-next-kube-deploy.sh: # kubectl set image + rollout + smoke # # Note: 必须用 office-wsl 主机名（不能是 office）！ # - office = Windows sshd (OpenSSH_for_Windows), 读 C:\Users\dell\.ssh\authorized_keys, 我们加不进去 key # - office-wsl = WSL2 Linux sshd, 读 /home/dell/.ssh/authorized_keys, cmdb-jenkins 公钥已写入 set -euo pipefail
GIT_REF="${GIT_REF:-main}" OFFICE_HOST="dell@office-wsl" # 注意是 office-wsl, 不是 office MASTER_HOST="huangfra-ubun-master@100.96.54.109" KUBE_NS="new-ecommerce" DEPLOY="flower-next" REGISTRY="100.76.15.64:5001"
echo "==================================================" echo "flower-next-office-deploy" echo "GIT_REF=$GIT_REF" echo "OFFICE_HOST=$OFFICE_HOST" echo "=================================================="
#-------------------------------------------------------------------- # Step 1: Office WSL builds + pushes image #-------------------------------------------------------------------- echo echo "======= [1/3] Office WSL: build flower-next image + push to Mac Mini registry =======" COMMIT_SHA=$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=30 "$OFFICE_HOST" \ "GIT_REF='$GIT_REF' ~/bin/flower-next-office-build.sh") COMMIT_SHA="$(echo "$COMMIT_SHA" | tail -n 1 | tr -d '[:space:]')" echo "Built and pushed image with SHA: $COMMIT_SHA" [ -n "$COMMIT_SHA" ] || { echo "FAIL: empty COMMIT_SHA"; exit 1; }
#-------------------------------------------------------------------- # Step 2: ubuntu-master kubectl deploy #-------------------------------------------------------------------- echo echo "======= [2/3] ubuntu-master: kubectl set image + rollout =======" ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=30 "$MASTER_HOST" \ "SHA='$COMMIT_SHA' ~/bin/flower-next-kube-deploy.sh"
#-------------------------------------------------------------------- # Step 3: smoke #-------------------------------------------------------------------- echo echo "======= [3/3] smoke =======" POD=$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes "$MASTER_HOST" \ "kubectl -n $KUBE_NS get pod -l app=$DEPLOY --field-selector=status.phase=Running --no-headers -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name | head -1 | tr -d '[:space:]'") echo "Running pod: $POD" [ -n "$POD" ] || { echo "FAIL: no running pod"; exit 1; } echo "OK k3s deployment $DEPLOY rolled out with image $REGISTRY/flower-next:$COMMIT_SHA"
echo echo "======= DEPLOY SUCCESS: $COMMIT_SHA ======="
